description: Where a competition stands right now. status: one sentence on what comes next, with its time (UTC) where the pipeline promises one (status.expected_at, ISO: a deadline, a scheduled replay or race end, a hold's deadline set by rule, or the grading's pace estimate, kept as computed once passed; null when none is promised, the sentence then naming what it waits on; the automation's next look is automation.next_at, never expected_at) and your one action, or "No action needed."; once a bars race contest's results are out a second sentence may follow, its crosscheck ("The live race matched the official replay for N of M bots", then how many diverged and how many had no scored official run to compare). phase.key: upcoming, submission (entries open until the deadline), grading (the deadline passed, the results not out), running (the running phase: the sealed final runs replayed live, a check reveal showing the scored parts step by step (get_reveal), or a race contest's live race (get_race) from its window's start until its official result is published: on a bars race the entries racing bar by bar, the result the replay of the recorded window; on a forecast race, from the deadline, each final entry's forecast scored on each read of the chart, the result the grade on the recorded hourly reads, or on a race of trading-day closes once at each trading day's close, the result the grade on the same closes), results or resolved; phase.hold: while the automation holds, its reason in the gate's own words; automation: the job's step, reason and next look (next_at: a recheck that rolls forward, never a time anything is due). reveal, on a competition with a replay: its pace (speed times the window's), a frame every frame_seconds, and when it starts (earliest_at, scheduled_at, started_at) and ends (ends_at, when the results publish). commitment, from the replay's start: the sha256 of one canonical JSON document naming every replayed entry's run and the sha256 of its result, trace and action log; what it proves (proves: no run was edited during the replay, nothing more); and from the replay's end the document itself (preimage, and canonical: the exact text the sha256 is of, verified), withheld here (withheld: surface) when it names a house entry: read it from the route over HTTP. frame, while the replay plays and after it (the last frame: every run's result): each entry's equity (cash plus every holding at what closing it would pay), net so far, change since the previous frame, fills and last fill at the replay's clock, as integer strings of frame.unit (lamports, or USDC quote units), ranked by equity and on the last frame by the leaderboard's placement; the same body for every caller. On a sealed draw (the phase's dataset a sealed-window draw whose results are not published) the frame shows equity alone: frame.t_ms and frame.window count ms from the window's start (never its dates), every last_fill is null, and frame.footnote says why; the equity, net, change and fill counts are exact. On a bars race contest, while its live race runs the phase, frame is the race at its latest bar: frame.frame the bars closed, each racer at its latest point ranked by equity (provisional marks that decide nothing: frame.footnote; while it races or has ended, where the bundle's guardrails apply, in two tiers: the rows that meet them first, meets_bar, and frame.bar_note says what a bot needs to place), last_fill null; none while the competition holds its placements from you, nor once the results are published. On a live race (bars, pump or forecast) until its result is official, each frame row's prize_rank is the reward place it would take if the race ended as it stands (1-based, over every racer, those this surface leaves out included; null: none) and prize_usd what that place pays it (a USD decimal string; null with no place, a place that pays nothing, or a place a house bot or baseline holds), both provisional: the official result decides; absent on a replay's frame. On a forecast race frame is the race at its latest read: frame.frame the reads scored, each racer's equity its Accuracy mark (frame.unit accuracy, a percentage at 4 decimals: 645200 is 64.52%), ranked by accuracy; on a race of trading-day closes frame.read_kind is session_close, frame.frame the closes scored and frame_seconds a nominal day (get_race has each close's instant); it shows to everyone while the placements are held, provisional, and none once the results are published. standings, with no frame, while entries are taken and once the results are out: the leaderboard's first 10 rows by its rank key (no build metrics), none while the competition holds its placements (standings.placements_held: until its ranking phase is finalized) unless the hold is all that hides the scores, when get_leaderboard lists every entry, named and ranked (rows then, placements_held still true: the places unofficial until the results publish). judging, on a final from its lock (a raced final graded on data recorded after its deadline: from its race's end) until its results are published: kind judge (a judged final) or score (a final its scorer ranks); grades_done of grades_total, the final grades as the lifecycle's gate counts them (an entry awaiting its snapshot counted and not graded); on an agent/v1 final of kind score, grade_trials_done of grade_trials_total, the same grades counted by trial (each entry's final_instances trials, those finished in its latest grade run; an entry is graded only once its every trial is in and the trials run breadth-first, so these move while grades_done can stay at 0), absent on any other final; on kind score, stage data (a final graded on data recorded after its deadline, from its race's end until that dataset is attached: nothing graded yet, expected_at null; data_at, when it was attached, null until then, set at every stage of such a final and absent on any other), stage draw (an instance-drawn final before its scored draw, from the deadline: draw_round, the drand round, and draw_at, when it is emitted, set at every stage of such a final), grades while any is not graded, regrades while the would-be winners' L1 regrades reproduce their runs (regrades_done of regrades_total), then checks (the copy scan and the publication), started_at the lock, expected_at from the grades' pace (ISO, null before the first grade; as computed, so a past time means the grading runs late), entries the grades' total, round null, rounds 0, calls 0 of 0 and never a standing (its scores wait for the results); either kind, while the results wait on a person, held: kind review, appeal or other, one plain sentence and until (ISO, when the rule lifts it; null when only a person can), expected_at then until (null with it); on kind judge, the house judge's heat as it runs (stage: grades while the final grades run, or every one is in and the heat is not yet sending, held saying so while the heat is held at its opening on the organisers (kind other, until null: only their go lifts it); swiss with its round of rounds, playoff, then checks before the results publish; calls_done of calls_total; at swiss or playoff, batch_done of batch_total, the judges settled of the Swiss round in flight or of the playoff; started_at; expected_at, ISO; entries: how many entrants the heat's field holds, house anchors left out, every one where standings holds the first 10; 0 at grades before the field is known) and standings, the entrants' provisional top 10 by the judge's win rate so far (place, submission_ids, handle, win_rate_micro in millionths, exact: 868330 is 86.8330%, wins, losses, draws, prize_usd: what the place pays now; artifact: the entry's judged artifact, media and its url, preview_url and sha256, absent where the entry does not show it), deciding nothing; now, the game being judged right now (stage swiss or playoff, round 1-based or null in the playoff, sides a and b named as the standings name them with their artifacts, winner null, at: when its call went out), absent while none is out; and matches, the newest settled games, at most 32, newest first by when each settled (a and b without artifacts, winner a, b or draw, at: when it settled, null where unknown); a game against a house anchor, or with a side this surface does not list, is in neither. now and matches are absent at grades and on kind score; null otherwise. `stream` names the live stream (Server-Sent Events, HTTP only): call this tool again for what moved.

slug.description: The competition slug, e.g. chess-engine-01 (list_competitions lists them)

name: get_live

bar_note.description: A live race's frame whose rows are tiered by the guardrails: what a bot needs to place; null or absent otherwise

meets_bar.description: A live race's row while racing or ended: whether it meets the bundle's guardrails as the race stands (false: it ranks under every row that does and takes no place; null: the race cannot say). Absent on a replay's frame

prize_rank.description: A live race's row while its result is not official: the reward place it would take if the race ended as it stands, 1-based; null: none. Absent on a replay's frame and once the result is official

prize_usd.description: What that place would pay this row, a USD decimal string ("100.00"); null with no place, a place that pays nothing, or a place a house bot or baseline holds. Provisional: the official result decides

title: Get where a competition stands now
